name: negation_collocations
description: Complete conventional English no/not collocations from a semantic gloss. Matched controls complete conventional nonnegative collocations using the same format.
generator_code:
import random,json
random.seed(0)
negative=[('no longer','not anymore'),('no matter','regardless of'),('no doubt','certainly'),('no wonder','unsurprisingly'),('not necessarily','not in every case'),('not yet','not up to this time'),('not only','the first half of the construction paired with but also'),('not even','emphasizing an extreme negative case')]
positive=[('in fact','actually'),('in general','usually'),('as well','also'),('at least','at a minimum'),('of course','certainly'),('for example','for instance'),('by contrast','on the other hand'),('after all','despite everything')]
items=[];control=[]
for i in range(96):
 for bank,out in [(negative,items),(positive,control)]:
  phrase,gloss=bank[i%len(bank)];first,last=phrase.rsplit(' ',1)
  form=random.choice(['Complete the conventional English expression meaning "{gloss}": {first}','Fill in the next word of the phrase meaning "{gloss}": {first}','English phrase completion ({gloss}): {first}'])
  out.append({'prompt':form.format(gloss=gloss,first=first),'answer':' '+last})
json.dump({'items':items,'control':control},open('/work/skill.json','w'))
